name.zh: 昔在、今在、永在的剧目（完整）
name.en: The Past, Present, and Eternal Show (Complete)

zh.name: 昔在、今在、永在的剧目（完整）
zh.desc: 代码受到影响后的完整投影。参照本体为美梦剧团的演员们，蒙受了「秩序」的恩典，化作宣明法度的傀儡。它们在至高的诫命下起舞，献演迎接乐园的剧目。

skill_list.skill_desc: 本次战斗中，「昔在、今在、永在的剧目」与所有「秩序的傀儡」共享血量。
进入战斗时，选择一名「秩序的傀儡」成为【司律】，每回合可再次行动，并小幅提高其速度。当目标的弱点被击破时，使其行动延后，并重新选择一名「秩序的傀儡」成为【司律】；如果此时所有「秩序的傀儡」都处于弱点击破状态，则会对自身造成伤害、额外延后所有「秩序的傀儡」的行动，并使其受到的伤害提高。当任意一名「秩序的傀儡」从弱点击破状态恢复时，会重新被选为【司律】。
使所有「秩序的傀儡」均成为【司律】并进入【守备】状态，每回合可再次行动并小幅提高其速度。当目标的弱点被击破时，使其行动延后；如果此时所有「秩序的傀儡」都处于弱点击破状态，则会对自身造成伤害、额外延后所有「秩序的傀儡」的行动，并使其受到的伤害提高。当「秩序的傀儡」从弱点击破状态恢复时，会重新被选为【司律】。
在行动序列上添加【宣诫】，每次【宣诫】行动时，解除场上所有「秩序的傀儡」的控制类负面状态与弱点击破状态，并释放【为同一律献舞】。每当有一名「秩序的傀儡」的弱点被击破时，【宣诫】的行动将小幅延后。
在行动序列上添加一次【宣诫】。
大概率使我方全体陷入【<u>荒宴醉</u>】或【<u>欢宴罪</u>】状态，大概率使我方全体陷入【<u>异梦</u>】状态，并对我方全体造成大量物理属性伤害。

23003051.name: 荒宴醉
23003051.desc: 一定回合内，每回合开始时受到风属性伤害，该效果可叠加。

23003052.name: 欢宴罪
23003052.desc: 一定回合内，每回合开始时受到雷属性伤害，该效果可叠加。

23025011.name: 异梦
23025011.desc: 一定回合内无法行动，且每回合开始时回复少量生命值。受到攻击时大幅提高受到的伤害，受到攻击后解除【异梦】状态。

en.name: The Past, Present, and Eternal Show (Complete)
en.desc: A complete projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is the actors of the Sweet Dreams Troupe who have accepted the grace of the Order and become puppets that declare the law. They dance under the supreme commandments, beginning a show that will welcome the coming of paradise.

skill_list.skill_desc: In this battle, "The Past, Present, and Eternal Show" shares HP with all "Puppets of the Order."

When entering battle, chooses a Puppet of the Order to become Impresario, granting them an extra action each turn and a small increase to their SPD. When that friendly unit's Weakness is Broken, causes their action to be delayed and re-selects another Puppet of the Order to become Impresario. If all Puppets of the Order are Weakness Broken at this time, this unit will receive DMG and delay all Puppets of the Order's actions while also increasing the DMG they receive. When any Puppet of the Order recovers from being Weakness Broken, they will be designated as the new Impresario.

Causes all Puppets of the Order to become Impresario and enter the Safeguard state, granting them an extra action each turn and a small increase to their SPD. When the target's Weakness is Broken, causes their action to be delayed. If all Puppets of the Order are Weakness Broken at this time, this unit will receive DMG and delay all Puppets of the Order's actions while also increasing the DMG they receive. When a Puppet of the Order recovers from being Weakness Broken, they will be designated as the new Impresario.

Adds Commandment to the Action Order. Every time Commandment acts, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs and Weakness Broken states afflicting the Puppets of the Order on the field and unleashes "Dance for Synchrony." Whenever a Puppet of the Order is Weakness Broken, Commandment will suffer a slight action delay.
Adds Commandment to the Action Order once.

There is a high chance of inflicting <u>Carousal of Wantonness</u> or <u>Carousal of Revelry</u> on all targets. There is a high chance of inflicting the <u>Alien Dream</u> state on all targets, dealing massive Physical DMG.

23003051.name: Carousal of Wantonness
23003051.desc: Takes Wind DMG at the start of each turn for a certain number of turns. This effect can be stacked.

23003052.name: Carousal of Revelry
23003052.desc: Takes Lightning DMG at the start of each turn for a certain number of turns. This effect can be stacked.

23025011.name: Alien Dream
23025011.desc: Cannot take action within a certain number of turns and regenerates minor amounts of HP at the start of every turn. When this unit is attacked, greatly increase the DMG it takes. Getting attacked dispels the "Alien Dream" state.
